mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS productId, p.product_code AS productCode, p.product_name AS productName, p.unit AS unit, p.stock_min AS stockMin, p.stock_max AS stockMax, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(s.quantity), 4), 0) AS stockQty, CASE WHEN IFNULL(SUM(s.quantity), 0) <= 0 THEN '已缺货' ELSE '低于下限' END AS warnType FROM jxc_product p LEFT JOIN jxc_stock s ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE p.status = '0' GROUP BY p.id, p.product_code, p.product_name, p.unit, p.stock_min, p.stock_max HAVING IFNULL(SUM(s.quantity), 0) <= p.stock_min ORDER BY stockQty ASC

SELECT p.product_code AS productCode, p.product_name AS productName, p.unit AS unit, s.batch_no AS batchNo, s.expiry_date AS expiryDate, DATEDIFF(s.expiry_date, CURDATE()) AS daysToExpiry, s.quantity AS quantity, ROUND(s.quantity * s.cost_price, 2) AS stockAmount FROM jxc_stock s LEFT JOIN jxc_product p ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE s.quantity > 0 AND s.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(s.expiry_date, CURDATE()) <= #{days} ORDER BY s.expiry_date ASC
